# Art checklist (generated by `node tools/art_checklist.js`)

Put images in the `art/` folder using these names (PNG or WebP, transparent background unless noted). Then run `npm run art` (or just `npm run build`). Anything missing keeps the built-in painted art, so you can replace things gradually.

A name with an upgrade suffix (`castle1_3`) wins over the base name (`castle1`); if you only supply the base, every upgrade level uses it (the game still adds its glow and stars).

## The imported art pack (what is in art/ today)
Produced by `node tools/import_assets.js "<path to the pack src/assets>"` (small WebP files). Every file is optional: anything missing keeps the painted-in-code art.
- `portraits/<id>.webp` and `portraits/<id>_up.webp` — square creature paintings used in the frames (base and upgraded picture)
- `poses/<left|right>/<idle|fighting|defending>/<id>[_up].webp` — battle sprites (right = your side, left = the enemy), loaded when a fight starts
- `heroes/<name>.webp` — hero portraits; `mounted/<name>_<north|east|south|west>.webp` — the hero on the adventure map
- `objects/…`, `terrain/…` (ground textures plus tree and mountain overlays), `icons/res_*`, `flags/<colour>.webp` (the eight player flags)
- `ui/title.webp`, `ui/castle_select.webp`, `ui/hero_select.webp`, `ui/town_<castle>.webp` — screen backgrounds and castle pictures

## Town buildings — `art/buildings/…`
256×288 (a little taller than wide), building standing on the bottom edge, transparent background. Name patterns, most specific wins: `<castle>_<kind>_<level>`, `<kind>_<level>`, `<castle>_<kind>`, `<kind>`.

- `buildings/hall_<level>   e.g. buildings/hall_2, buildings/castle_hall_2`
- `buildings/guild_<level>   e.g. buildings/guild_2, buildings/castle_guild_2`
- `buildings/market_<level>   e.g. buildings/market_2, buildings/castle_market_2`
- `buildings/ship_<level>   e.g. buildings/ship_2, buildings/castle_ship_2`
- `buildings/fort_<level>   e.g. buildings/fort_2, buildings/castle_fort_2`
- `buildings/mines_<level>   e.g. buildings/mines_2, buildings/castle_mines_2`
- `buildings/tavern_<level>   e.g. buildings/tavern_2, buildings/castle_tavern_2`
- `buildings/garrison_<level>   e.g. buildings/garrison_2, buildings/castle_garrison_2`
- ``
- `Creature dwellings: `buildings/<creature id>` (e.g. `buildings/castle1`, `buildings/castle1_3`) — one per castle creature and level, or just the base.`
- `Castles are: castle, rampart, tower, inferno, necropolis, dungeon, stronghold, fortress, conflux`

## Map objects — `art/objects/<type>.png`
128×128, transparent, standing on the bottom edge.

- `town (or `town_<castle>`)`
- `fort`
- `mine_gold, mine_wood, mine_ore, mine_mercury, mine_sulfur, mine_crystal, mine_gems`
- `pile_gold, pile_wood, … (resource piles)`
- `dwelling (or `dwelling_<castle>`)`
- `lair`
- `chest`
- `art (artifact on the ground)`
- `merchant`
- `wreck`
- `spring`
- `resobj_windmill, resobj_waterwheel, resobj_garden`
- `stone`
- `shrine`
- `tower`
- `bank_crypt, bank_utopia, bank_stockpile`
- `mono`
- `seer`
- `boat`

## Terrain tiles — `art/terrain/<type>.png`
64×74 pointy-top hexagon (the corners outside the hexagon transparent). Variants `grass_1…grass_4` are picked at random per tile.

- `grass`
- `forest`
- `mountain`
- `water`
- `road`
- `sand`
